title: Depth and client latency
caption: UDP at1QPS, five paired repeats per depth/cache state. Lines join the median block P50 of successful valid answers; whiskers show observed min–max across five blocks, not confidence intervals. Small markers are individual block summaries. No per-request independence or isolated per-hop cryptographic cost is inferred.
supported_manuscript_claims: Cold valid-answer block P50 increased across the configured depths, while hot authenticated latency stayed near200ms in this testbed.
limitations: Five paired repeats per condition, one physical testbed
Conditional-success latency may omit zero-success blocks; reliability retains all offered requests

title: Offered-rate sweep
caption: Depth3 UDP; 120s offered measurement windows with 30/60/120/240 requests at 0.25/0.5/1/2QPS. Top: median of conditional-success block P50; bottom: mean block valid-answer proportion. title: Pipelined versus serial
caption: Five within-condition paired repeats;positive values mean smaller conditional-success latency under pipelining. Diamonds equal100*(1-geometric mean of paired block-quantile ratios). Bars enumerate the empirical paired bootstrap2.5–97.5 percentiles, describing within-testbed repeat variability only. Small dots are all individual paired effects. These are not confirmatory randomized-test intervals;no condition-level significance claim is made.
supported_manuscript_claims: Pipelining had limited and condition-dependent changes versus the authenticated serial mode;UDP hot did not show a uniform gain.
